asr.training_data: 880 hours diverse Amharic audio (read, broadcast, calls, 5 regional dialects)
asr.documented_eval: 16.1% WER / 5.4% CER (model card claim; background only)
asr.limitations: Reduced accuracy with overlapping speakers; no punctuation; numbers spelled phonetically

llm.training_data: Pre-trained on multilingual datasets + instruction tuning
llm.limitations: Smaller general knowledge base but highly efficient; runs comfortably on T4 alongside audio pipelines

tts.documented_eval: Zero-shot Amharic synthesis, 24kHz output, ~3GB VRAM on T4
tts.limitations: This baseline measures blocking complete-waveform generation; true first-audio latency is not exposed by this benchmark implementation
